sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Falling Skies is a story chapter in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: "Mechanic and I got to talking about that plane that went down somewhere in the nature reserve. Nobody really knows what happened to it. I should track it down and take a look — maybe I'll find something interesting."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Ask Mechanic about the downed plane while progressing through the story chapter Tour.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the fallen plane
- Reach Loyalty Level 2 with Prapor
- Ask the traders about the fallen plane
- (Optional) Hand over 2,000 USD to Therapist to learn details about the SUV
- Retrieve the flash drive from one of the G-Wagon SUVs
- Hand over the flash drive to Prapor
- Wait for information from Prapor
- Retrieve the plane's flight recorder
- Leave the flight recorder in the specified spot
- Visit Prapor
- Hand over 3 found in raid Rechargeable batteries
- Hand over 5 found in raid Printed circuit boards
- Hand over 2 found in raid Toolsets
- Wait for information from Prapor
- Hand over the flight crew's transcript to Prapor
- Hand over Elektronik's secure flash drive to Prapor
- Wait for information from Prapor
- Retrieve the armored case
  - (Optional) Find any additional clues
- Keep the armored case for yourself or hand it over to Prapor

sections.heading: Locate the fallen plane
sections.text: The fallen plane is located on the eastern side of Woods.

sections.heading: Speak to Prapor
sections.text: Visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the fallen plane.

sections.heading: Reach Loyalty Level 2 with Prapor
sections.text: To get further information about the plane, you have to reach loyalty level 2 with Prapor and then ask him again about the fallen plane.

sections.heading: Ask the traders about the fallen plane
sections.text: Visit Prapor, Therapist, Skier, Mechanic and Jaeger in the menu through the trader screen and ask them about the fallen plane.

sections.heading: (Optional) Hand over 2,000 USD to Therapist to learn details about the SUV
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Dollars | 2,000 | Handover item | No |
Visit Therapist in the menu through the trader screen and ask her about information on the fallen plane. Upon handing over 2,000 USD, she reveals the position of the wanted SUV.

sections.heading: Retrieve the flash drive from one of the G-Wagon SUVs
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| G-Wagon flash drive | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
The G-Wagon flash drive can be found on the driver side running board of the G-Wagon SUV next to the "Tunnel" extraction on Shoreline.

Hand the G-Wagon flash drive over to Prapor through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Wait for the information from Prapor
sections.text: Wait 1 hour then visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the fallen plane.

sections.heading: Retrieve the plane's flight recorder
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Crashed plane's flight recorder | 1 | Required | Yes |
The fallen plane is located on the eastern side of Woods, where the Crashed plane's flight recorder can be found on the right side of the plane in the broken section near the back.

sections.heading: Leave the flight recorder in the specified spot
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Crashed plane's flight recorder | 1 | Required | N/A | Stashed item |
The Crashed plane's flight recorder has to be stashed at the destroyed room in the house on the Shoreline island.

sections.heading: Visit Prapor
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Toolset | 2 | Handover item | Yes | Can be crafted in the Hideout (Workbench lv. 1). |
| Rechargeable battery | 3 | Handover item | Yes | Can be crafted in the Hideout (Workbench lv. 2). |
| Printed circuit board | 5 | Handover item | Yes | Can be crafted in the Hideout (Workbench lv. 1). |
Prapor asks for these items to continue.

sections.heading: Wait for the information from Prapor
sections.text: Wait 3-5 hours then visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the fallen plane.

sections.heading: Hand over the flight crew's transcript and Elektronik's secure flash drive to Prapor
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Plane crew transcript | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
| Elektronik's flash drive | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
Both items can be found in the chairman's house on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
You will receive the reward once you hand over both items.
- 300,000 Roubles
  - 315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

sections.heading: Wait for the information from Prapor
sections.text: Wait 1-3 hours then visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the fallen plane. Prapor asks if you read the transcript and if you answer with yes, you'll get a reward, if you answer with no you won't.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- 300,000 Roubles
  - 315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

sections.heading: Retrieve the armored case/Find any additional clues
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Armored case | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
| Note from Mr. Kerman | 1 | Optional | Yes |
The Armored case can be found behind the cockpit of the fallen plane, and the optional Note from Mr. Kerman is located on the pilot seat.

sections.heading: Keep the armored case for yourself or hand it over to Prapor
sections.text: This is an important point of no return choice! The rewards differ depending on the decision.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +80,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep -0.7
- 1× Armored case
- Unlocks achievement Just Business

sections.heading: Decision: Hand over the armored case directly to Prapor
Rewards
sections.text:
- +80,000 EXP
- 1,500,000 Roubles
- Unlocks achievement Man of His Word

sections.heading: Decision: Pretend you didn't find the armored case, but still hand it over to Prapor
Rewards
sections.text:
- +80,000 EXP
- 1,000,000 Roubles
- Unlocks achievement Man of His Word
